objective: Package DataForge scenario generation outputs into deterministic SQLite databases and portable JSON snapshots for offline DashForge runtime ingestion.

journeys.name: Generate deterministic healthcare SQLite database and JSON snapshot
journeys.goal: An author or operator generates a deterministic healthcare flu-season scenario SQLite database and derived JSON snapshot for offline workshop presentation.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --seed 3101 --output /tmp/flu-season.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/flu-season.snapshot.json --force
steps: Run env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --seed 3101 --output /tmp/flu-season.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/flu-season.snapshot.json --force.
Verify exit code is 0 and both the SQLite file and snapshot JSON file are created.
Verify the snapshot contains expected dataset IDs and valid column definitions matching DataAdapter schema.

journeys.name: Fail closed when target database or snapshot output path already exists without force flag
journeys.goal: An operator confirms that existing output files are protected against accidental overwrites by failing closed unless --force is explicitly provided.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --output /tmp/flu-season.sqlite
env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --output /tmp/flu-season.sqlite --force
steps: Attempt to generate to an existing output path without passing --force using env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --output /tmp/flu-season.sqlite.
Confirm the command exits with non-zero status and reports an informative error message regarding existing output files.
Re-run with --force using env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --output /tmp/flu-season.sqlite --force and confirm successful overwrite.

journeys.name: Generate financial services and SaaS pack scenario databases and snapshots
journeys.goal: A mission verifies that financial services and SaaS packs generate deterministic SQLite databases and JSON snapshots across supported scenarios.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack financial --scenario market-downturn --seed 5301 --output /tmp/financial.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/financial.snapshot.json --force
env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack saas --scenario churn-crisis --seed 8301 --output /tmp/saas.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/saas.snapshot.json --force
steps: Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with --pack financial --scenario market-downturn --seed 5301 --output /tmp/financial.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/financial.snapshot.json --force.
Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with --pack saas --scenario churn-crisis --seed 8301 --output /tmp/saas.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/saas.snapshot.json --force.
Confirm both pack generators produce valid SQLite tables and snapshot JSON structures.

journeys.name: Handle missing arguments and invalid scenario identifiers gracefully without tracebacks
journeys.goal: A human user verifies that invalid CLI invocations (e.g. unknown scenario or missing arguments) produce clean diagnostic error messages and non-zero exit codes without unhandled Python tracebacks.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario unknown-scenario --output /tmp/unknown.sqlite
steps: Run env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with an invalid or unknown scenario identifier.
Run env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main without required arguments.
Verify non-zero exit code and diagnostic stderr message without unhandled tracebacks.

journeys.name: Execute automated generator and snapshot test suite verifying data adapter compatibility
journeys.goal: A human reviewer executes the automated test suite to confirm determinism, snapshot structure, and compatibility with the DashForge data adapter.
steps: Confirm all test cases pass cleanly, verifying determinism, dataset export resolution, and schema compatibility.
